headline: Environmental Scrutiny Over Data Centers Intensifies Ahead of US Midterms
summary: Debates over data centres have intensified ahead of US midterm elections. Despite powering the digital world, growing concerns have emerged over their environmental impact.
why: Data centers underpin artificial intelligence and cloud computing infrastructure, but rising regulatory and environmental scrutiny creates grid capacity and permitting risks.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Heightened political and environmental debates may affect approvals and operational costs for data center infrastructure.
